item.title: As of today, Melissa Auf der Maur: My ‘9s Rock Photographs is ...
item.description: As of today, Melissa Auf der Maur: My ‘9s Rock Photographs is open to everyone. Come dive deep into the ‘9s through Auf der Maur’s lens. Celebrate the exhibition opening and photo book launch on September 9, from 6 – 9 pm! Remarks begin at 7 pm, with the artist and curators in attendance.At the event on September 9, Melissa Auf der Maur will be signing books. Book signing is on a first-come, first-served basis, with a dedicated lineup starting at 6 pm. We recommend getting your book in advance, at the shop, where you can also get the Bass Womb Room cassette, the exhibition soundtrack. Space will be limited for the signing; if you require accommodation, please let our Contact Centre know.We’re grateful to Signature Partner @rbc and the Generous Support of the Women’s Art Initiative for making this exhibition possible.•Melissa Auf der Maur, Courtney Commands Canadian Crowd, Edmonton, Canada, 1999. © Melissa Auf der MaurAll photos: © Melissa Auf der Maur

item.title: I ️PHOTOGRAPHYDream come true for teen photographer who first ...
item.description: I ️PHOTOGRAPHYDream come true for teen photographer who first witnessed magic in the red womb of the dark room …. Out tomorrow worldwide (but been seen out in the wild already, check a bookshop near you), my first photo book. This comes out in tandem and as a companion to my museum exhibition at the @agotorontoThis was no little lift. The archiving and scanning of my photographs has been ongoing for a decade, and in the last three years a system was crafted to make my archive interfaceable and not just fading and exploding boxes in my attic.With an incredible small team of curators and archivists, we combed through almost 15, photographic negatives, to make this … an attempt to deduce the essence of the archive, into photos, plus comprehensive essays and conversations which contextualize this archive within the history of photography, analog-to-digital, Gen X, counterculture, and women in the arts. Loving shout out to the contributors of the word, Kevin Moore @fultonstreet, Ann Powers @annkpowers @MichaelStipe, Stephan Jostago and Grace Elizabeth-Hale.Biggest thanks to AGO exhibit and book curators Sophie Hackett @hackettse & Jim Shedden @jimshedden, stellar archivist @kathydisco, book designers Alina Skyson @alinaskyson & Sara Wong @saraewong, project manager Robyn Lew @robynlew and copy editor Kieran Grant @mawkwind.Very excited to partner with DAP / Delmonico @artbook @delmonico_books as publishers, may we get this book into as many eager analogue hands as we can.Special thanks to @greendragonoffice for initial deep dive into the archive and @Jess_Chappe, @SoniaRuscoe and Maxwell Paparella @44getting for much much scanning!And to you, we made it for you, for us, to share in our love of weaving order out of chaos…xMxFirst Photo:MIND (Moving In New Directions) High School yearbookLast Photo:MAdM Archive Room, with @kathydisco at the helm … files at the finger tips and key word mistress of the ship

item.title: In her 6 memoir, Even the Good Girls Will Cry, @xmadmx writes at...
item.description: In her 6 memoir, Even the Good Girls Will Cry, @xmadmx writes at length about her lifelong shyness and the empowering experience of capturing the world around her through a camera. ⁠⁠When @joobinbekhrad meets her at the Art Gallery of Ontario, where she’s setting up for her solo exhibition My ‘9s Rock Photographs, she’s soft-spoken and gracious, but without the slightest trace of mauvaise honte, he says. Melissa tells it like it is.⁠⁠While the show features a couple of hundred photographs taken between the early Nineties – when a fortuitous meeting with Smashing Pumpkins frontman Billy Corgan eventually led to her joining Love’s band, Hole – and late , when the Pumpkins, whom she later joined, disbanded, Melissa’s vault is far larger. “My archive is 15, photographs, all printed, and then we had to scan them and reduce them to like, , which was the hardest thing of this entire memoir project. … I’d sit on my hotel bed on a day off [in the Nineties] and just sort of, like, spread all the photos out and try to make sense of it all.”⁠⁠Read the interview at the link in bio ⁠⁠ My ‘9s Rock Photographs by Melissa Auf der Mar. © @xmadmx⁠

item.title: NEW / OLD SONDS OT TODAY!!BASS WOMB ROOM: My ‘9s 4-Track Dem...
item.description: NEW / OLD SONDS OT TODAY!!BASS WOMB ROOM: My ‘9s 4-Track Demos x Field Recordings is a 15-track album, mostly written and recorded by Melissa Auf der Maur on her trusted Tascam 4-Track tape recorder in her home living room studios in the 9s“These songs were the sound of my internal experimentation and a way of keeping the Montreal art girl alive inside while playing in a major label rock band. A raw, weird, time capsule!”The album was produced by Auf der Maur and @a_crow Alex Crow, and is the soundtrack to the BASS WOMB ROOM, a video art installation (a GIANT IMMERSIVE MIRROR PYRAMID!!!) in her first museum exhibition opening next week at @agotorontoReleased first on cassette out today on @envisionmanagement TODAY, worldwide distribution on Linktree“Meet Me in the BASS WOMB ROOM”

item.title: COMMNAL GRIEF x HEALINGTHE STRANDFri September 11, 6 is the 5th ...
item.description: COMMNAL GRIEF x HEALINGTHE STRANDFri September 11, 6 is the 5th anniversary of the day that changed NYC forever … I was in New York that day, and watched the burning towers from the roof of the Chelsea Hotel where I lived. I believe that communing together around meaningful creative connection is a special way to observe this day and ACTIVATE COLLECTIVE GRIEF AND HEALING… I am honored to be invited back to the Strand to launch my photo book, My 9s Rock Photographs, where I will be in conversation with Kelefa Sanneh, an amazing thinker and New Yorker. It promises to be a mindful conversation about where the arts, culture and this country have traversed in the last two decades, since the turn of the millennium, and that significant day in New York City and our shared history. Through kindness, clear eyed-ness, and gathering, we can grieve together, in hopes of collective healing.OXYTOCIN IN THE BOOK STORE! xMxRIP GLORIA, KSAMA & DOLLY

item.title: Former Hole bassist Melissa Auf der Maur’s new photography boo...
item.description: Former Hole bassist Melissa Auf der Maur’s new photography book, ‘My ’9s Rock Photographs,’ “intimately captures the chaos of the iconic era in music and American youth culture.” Through an exclusive selection of images, Auf der Maur takes @harpersbazaarus through her time with Courtney Love and the gang.⁠⁠@julia__silverberg writes: “Auf der Maur’s photos from that time are more than a personal trove; they capture the essence of a particular moment in ’9s music, a pre-iPhone era from which ephemera is more rarefied and during which having a female band photographer who was also in the band was basically unheard of. The images distill that raw grunge spirit: backstage mirror pics, partying starlets, and, of course, hundreds of hotel rooms all rendered in blurred-out yet vivid colors and candid compositions. Around of these images are now compiled in Auf der Maur’s new book, ‘My ’9s Rock Photographs,’ coming out September 8 in conjunction with an exhibition at @agotoronto.”⁠⁠Full review via linkinbio.⁠⁠Monograph co-published by @delmonico_books ⁠Edited with text by @hackettse & @jimshedden ⁠Foreword by stephanjostago ⁠Text by @xmadmx @annkpowers @fultonstreet @michaelstipe & Grace Elizabeth Hale⁠⁠#melissaaufdermaur #madm #my9srockphotographs⁠⁠
